context: At the shrine, taking in the scene
purpose: Experience the shrine; teach まいり/時半/覆/パワー/サン/ロー/アウト/ロック

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ちゃんとおまいりして、お願い事した？
lines.en: Did you pray properly and make a wish?
lines.style: playful friend checking in warmly, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: したよ。八時半には着いてたしね。
lines.en: I did. We got here by eight-thirty after all.
lines.style: satisfied friend recalling the early start

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 木々が雪にすっぽり覆われて、きれい。
lines.en: The trees are completely blanketed in snow, so pretty.
lines.style: awed teen drinking in the view

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: この場所、本当にパワーをもらえる気がする。
lines.en: This place really feels like it gives you power.
lines.style: moved friend feeling the atmosphere, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 日差しが強いね。サングラス借りていい？
lines.en: The sun’s strong. Can I borrow your sunglasses?
lines.style: squinting friend making a quick request

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: どうぞ。ローカルな雰囲気が落ち着くね。
lines.en: Here. The local atmosphere is calming.
lines.style: relaxed teen savoring the mood, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: お昼はアウトドアの広場で食べよう。
lines.en: Let’s eat in the outdoor plaza at noon.
lines.style: organizing friend suggesting the spot, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ロックのリハーサル、もう始まってる。
lines.en: The rock rehearsal has already started.
lines.style: eager friend perking up at the sound
